description: 深色头发盘起，佩戴小型浅色发饰，穿浅色短袖上衣和深色碎花短裙。画面为接近全身的背面构图，头部略向侧面转动，双臂靠近栏杆。面部仅局部可见，头发全长无法判断。
description_en: Dark hair is worn in an updo with a small light-colored hair accessory. A light-colored short-sleeved top and a dark floral skirt are visible in a nearly full-length rear view, with the head turned slightly to one side and the arms near a railing. The face is only partly visible, and full hair length cannot be determined.

limitations: 面部仅局部可见，不判断精细面部特征或眼镜佩戴情况。
盘发使头发全长与自然纹理无法可靠判断。
头部区域原有细节较少；缩放不会增加真实细节。
头部与人物区域由 Agent 粗略估计，可能包含少量背景；不是检测器或分割模型的精确定位。
统计量不保留像素、定位坐标或空间布局，不是人脸生物识别模板，不能用于确认人物身份。
不同照片中的 p001 均为各自图片内的局部编号，不表示已核验为同一人物。
外观或图像统计不证明人物记录中的行为、评价或证据等级。
limitations_en: The face is only partly visible; fine facial characteristics and eyewear are not assessed.
The updo obscures full hair length and natural texture.
The head region has limited original detail; resizing does not add real detail.
The head and visible-person regions are coarse Agent estimates and may include background; no detector or segmentation model was used.
The statistics retain no pixels, region coordinates, or spatial layout, are not face biometric templates, and cannot establish identity.
Each p001 is local to its own image and does not confirm that images depict the same person.
Appearance and image statistics do not establish the behavior, evaluations, or evidence grades in the person record.
